note: Reference briefs for the Fort Knox / AwesomeX PREP pass (PROMPT_EPISODE2_FORT_KNOX_AWESOMEX_FOUNDATION.md, skills ep2-fort-knox-arc + ep2-hyperreal-scene-pipeline). Muapi GPT Image 2 renders these; tools/ep2_forge/muapi_ref.py reads this file. The Fort Knox DOOR and the carry-out pile are the Pascal spec and are deliberately NOT here (do not redesign them).
style_lock_env: Photorealistic cinematic concept still for a first-person western shooter, 'western Modern Warfare' art direction: warm low sun key light with teal-blue shadow fill, thin atmospheric haze, physically based materials (weathered timber, rusted riveted steel, packed dirt, gravel, bark, dust), natural film grain, 35mm lens at human eye height (1.6 m), high dynamic range, sharp detail, believable scale. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no logos, no user interface, no people, no close-up characters.
style_lock_object: Photorealistic product-style reference for 3D modelling: the single subject centred with generous margin on a seamless plain mid-grey studio backdrop, soft even key light with a gentle rim light, sharp focus, true materials (lacquer, chrome, leather, rubber, rust, scale, steel), no text, no logos, no people, only a soft contact shadow.

items.title: Hideout exit onto a road the quad can use
constraints: road 4-5 m wide, firm packed dirt
straight enough to read 100 m
rock mine mouth in the foreground
no vehicles in frame

views.name: hero
views.prompt: Looking OUT of a rough rock mine mouth at dawn onto a packed-dirt forest service road wide enough for an off-road quad bike (about 4.5 metres), deep tyre ruts, pine forest on both sides, low mist on the ground, the road curving gently left and rising over a far ridge. In the foreground an old narrow-gauge rail track ends at the mine mouth, a rusted chain and a spoked cart wheel lean on the rock wall, fallen needles and leaf litter underfoot.

items.title: Inferno Bull's flame designer quad (one quad, then none)
constraints: carries a 2.9 m bull + a rifleman on a long back seat
candy red + layered flame paint
rear seat/rack must read as a shooting position
real vehicle proportions, chunky tyres

views.name: hero_3q
views.prompt: A custom hand-painted FLAME DESIGNER QUAD bike (all-terrain vehicle) built big enough to carry a huge driver and a rifleman behind him: deep candy-apple red lacquer body, layered airbrushed orange-and-yellow flame tongues licking back from the nose along both flanks and over the front fenders, polished chrome handlebars, bull bar and a long tubular chrome rear rack, a long black leather bench seat, a round chrome headlight with a guard, wide knobby off-road tyres, a little dried mud and honest wear. Three-quarter front view from the left, the whole vehicle in frame.

views.name: side
views.prompt: The exact same quad bike, identical flame design and parts, shown in a perfect side elevation (orthographic feel, camera level with the axles), the whole vehicle in frame.

views.name: rear_3q
views.prompt: The exact same quad bike, identical flame design and parts, rear three-quarter view from the left showing the long leather bench seat, the chrome rear rack and the back of the flame paint.

items.title: Spy point: sightline to the neighbouring building AND the vault approach
constraints: prone eye height 0.5-1 m behind ferns + a log
building at 80-120 m left, vault road straight ahead
bear camp smoke in the valley
nothing blocks either sightline

views.name: hero
views.prompt: A prone first-person view from behind a bank of ferns and a fallen mossy log on a wooded ridge crest at golden hour, looking down a long gentle slope. In the middle distance on the left, beside a gravel road junction, stands an old timber-and-stone storehouse with big double doors facing the road and fuel drums stacked against its wall, with a clear unobstructed line of sight to it. Straight ahead and further away the gravel road runs dead straight across open ground to a massive fortified vault compound of riveted steel and granite with watchtowers, the road and the gate approach clearly visible. Smoke from a bear camp's campfires rises in the valley below. Foreground ferns frame the bottom edge of the shot.

items.title: The building that takes the quad and reads as an explosion
constraints: doors wide enough for a quad
fuel drums + propane visible BEFORE the blast (the player must read it as explosive)
after: fireball, shockwave, debris, smoke column - not a grey box

views.name: intact
views.prompt: A weathered two-storey timber-and-stone supply and fuel storehouse standing alone at a road junction in open scrubland, late afternoon: wide double barn doors big enough for a vehicle to drive through, a loading platform, a row of rusty fuel drums and two propane tanks stacked along the side wall, hay bales, a sagging shingle roof with a stone chimney, a wooden water tower behind. Eye-level view from the road, the building fills the frame, everything crisp and believable.

views.name: exploding
views.prompt: The very same building a moment after a quad bike has crashed through the double doors: a huge orange-and-yellow fuel explosion bursts out of the doors and windows, a fireball and a shockwave dust ring, planks and shingles flying, secondary explosions from the fuel drums, a thick black smoke column climbing into the sky, embers everywhere, a hot glow on the ground. A real explosion, not a grey box. Same camera position and framing as the reference.

items.title: The Fort Knox approach road (NOT the vault door)
constraints: straight gravel road ~300 m
cover along the road (wrecked carts, crates)
gatehouse + towers read as a fortress
never show the vault door or interior (Pascal spec)

views.name: hero
views.prompt: The approach to Fort Knox at dusk: a long straight gravel road across open ground leading to a massive fortified vault compound of riveted steel plates and rough granite, a floodlit gatehouse, watchtowers, razor wire and sandbags, the silhouette of the vault block against an orange sky, burned-out mine carts and broken crates along the roadside for cover, an eye-level view down the road about 300 metres from the gate. The vault door and the interior are not visible.

items.title: Return trail wide enough for a bear line behind Lil Blunt
constraints: 8-10 m wide
200 m straight sightline back
mist + torch line far behind = a pursuing line of bears
cover logs along the edges

views.name: hero
views.prompt: A very wide forest trail (about ten metres across) at dusk, deep fresh tyre ruts and trampled undergrowth running straight for two hundred metres, tall pines on both sides, fallen logs along the edges, thick low mist. Far down the trail a long line of torches and lanterns carried by a pursuing mob of tiny distant bear silhouettes glows in the haze. Eye-level view looking back along the trail.

items.title: AwesomeX the dragon: design + entrance (air or furnace), machine guns visible
constraints: a DRAGON (DragonX / AwesomeX), brand colour GREEN
machine guns clearly visible
he leads the bulls and burns things
not on the quad, not in the vault
NO text, no logos in the render

views.name: design
views.prompt: Character design for AwesomeX, the heroic DRAGON mascot of a 'burn' protocol: a heavily muscled upright emerald-green dragon with glossy scales and gold-trimmed horns, wearing a western war harness of oiled leather and riveted steel with a belt of brass shells across the chest, two compact belt-fed machine guns mounted on his shoulders (clearly visible), a furnace-orange glow in his throat, folded bat-like wings, a confident grin. Full body, standing, three-quarter view.

views.name: entrance_air
views.prompt: The same emerald-green dragon in the same war harness swooping low through smoke over a forest trail at dusk, wings spread wide, both shoulder-mounted machine guns firing with bright muzzle flashes and tracer fire, a rolling jet of dragon fire sweeping over a line of charging bears (tiny distant silhouettes), dramatic low angle, embers and sparks, cinematic.

views.name: entrance_furnace
views.prompt: The same emerald-green dragon in the same war harness bursting out of a giant industrial smelter furnace mouth at night in an explosion of molten sparks and fire, glowing slag chunks flying, steam, the shoulder-mounted machine guns glowing hot and aimed forward, silhouettes of bears scattering in the background, cinematic.

items.title: Where Bull was pinned: down, NOT a corpse
constraints: Inferno Bull is ALIVE: eyes half open, breathing, a fist clenched
pinned under a fallen beam in a trench by a broken gate
a rope-and-lantern marker = the rescue mark
readable at 20 m as 'go back for him'

views.name: hero
views.prompt: Inferno Bull, the huge muscular bull with a miner's helmet with horns and a red bandana exactly as in the reference images, lying DOWN on his side in a trench beside a broken wooden gate, ALIVE and breathing: eyes half open, one fist clenched in the dirt, pinned under a fallen timber beam. A knocked-over lantern still glows beside him, torn sandbags, dust and drifting embers; a rope tied to a lantern post marks the spot. Dusk, low angle, clearly hurt but definitely not dead.
